summaries.summary: No clear winner in Israel's election as voting results come in, with discussion surrounding party performance and potential coalitions.
Apple introduces a touchscreen MacBook Pro, significantly raising the pricing benchmark for laptops.
Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to enhance its voice AI capabilities, while Amazon updates Alexa for better shopping list management.
A Russian attack on a Dnipro train station results in at least 13 deaths, amidst ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
Cyclone Arnab has impacted regions across India, causing flooding and prompting government responses.
Pokémon Legends: Z-A is offering a special promotion allowing users to receive unique Pokémon.
Microsoft reveals its Azure cloud service's quarterly revenue, indicating a strong competitive position against AWS.
Opposition parties in India plan to hold a mock Parliament to 'impeach' the Chief Election Commissioner amid ongoing electoral controversies.
